sample.method: mulberry32 Fisher-Yates over the 19,506 distinct vendor stems (sorted) found in site/data/ocp_awards_warehouse_lookup.json (53,992 rows) and site/data/analytics_registered_contracts/shard-000.json and shard-001.json; each stem is represented by its most frequent raw spelling

strategy.step_1_exact_upper_raw: upper(current_entity_name) in (<10 upper-cased raw names>) , one request per 10 names, LIMIT 500
strategy.step_2_token_prefix: for names without a step 1 hit: vendorStem -> alphanumeric tokens, AND dropped -> upper(current_entity_name) like 'T1%T2%...%' LIMIT 26 (25 + 1 to detect the cap); returned rows are compared client-side by exact name, vendorStem equality, or vendorStem equality with AND removed
strategy.note: vendorStem cannot run server-side, so the stem is applied on the 26 returned candidates, not in the query.

requests.note: A first pass without AND handling issued 256 token queries; 167 were re-issued after the AND/& rule was added and their results replaced. 'total' counts only requests behind the final per-name results. All requests: 1.1 s spacing, 0 failures, 0 timeouts above 30 s.

step_2_latency_ms.note: one 6052 ms outlier among 256 queries; this is why the route budget is 5000 ms with a source-unavailable answer, never a hang

full_universe_estimate.basis: scaled from the sample's measured step rates; an estimate, labelled as such

review.selection: seeded random 50 of the 143 single-match pairs (seed 20261114)

criteria.same: names equal after punctuation, '&'/and and legal-suffix folding AND the same legal form on both sides AND nothing in the engine contract context (agency, title) contradicts the state record
criteria.different: the legal form differs between vendor and state record, or the context contradicts
criteria.cannot_tell: vendor name carries no legal form and is generic, or the state record's type does not fit the vendor's apparent kind

review.address_note: Neither engine artifact (ocp_awards_warehouse_lookup.json: request_id,start_date,agency_name,type_of_notice_description,short_title,pin,contract_amount,vendor_name; analytics_registered_contracts shards: no vendor address field) carries a vendor address, so city and zip could not be compared for any of the 50 pairs. The state-side address is not a reliable location anyway: for many foreign entities it is the Secretary of State process address in Albany 12207.

Usefulness clears 0.30 but reviewed precision is below 0.95 on either reading, and the failures are structural: vendorStem deletes legal-form words, so INC./LLC/COMPANY siblings collapse. State matches are published as candidates with their match basis, never as automatic links.
